evidence: The experimental pulsing times of precursors were sufficiently long in order to obtain surface saturation on the planar substrate. The standard pulsing sequence in one cycle combines two pulsing sequences of Cp2ZrCl2 (pulses 1–4) followed by one pulsing sequence of Y(thd)3 (pulses 5–8). The deposition temperature was 300 8C. Film depositions were carried out at 2–3 mbar pressure.
